noSyncKeysBody: This build has no sync keys, so DayForge is working entirely in this browser — which is exactly how it has always worked. Adding {urlVar} and {keyVar} to the project's .env turns an account on, once the tables in {schema} have been created.
signInTitle: Sign in or create an account
signInBody: Keep the same projects, tasks and tracked time on every device.
legalAgree: By signing in you agree to the {terms} and {privacy}.
newHere: New here? The same button creates the account. Without one nothing leaves this browser, and everything keeps working as it does now.
firstSignInNote: Your existing projects and tasks are kept. The first sign-in brings them together with whatever the account already holds, and tucks a copy of the current state away first — see Backup and data in settings.
refusedChanges: {count} change the server refused | {count} changes the server refused
refusedNote: Retrying these will not help on its own, so they were set aside rather than left to block everything behind them.
nothingLost: Nothing is lost while they wait. They are stored here and sent once there is a connection.
signOutNote: Signing out sends any unsent changes first, then removes this account's projects, tasks and time from this browser. They stay on the server and come back when you sign in again.
signOutOffline: You're offline. This browser will be signed out and its data cleared; the session on the server will expire on its own.
unsyncedChanges: {count} change hasn't synced yet. Signing out now deletes it from this browser. | {count} changes haven't synced yet. Signing out now deletes them from this browser.
deleteAccountNote: Permanently deletes your account and all of its data on the server. This device's copy is erased too.
offlineDelete: Connect to the internet to delete your account.
deleteDialogBody: This permanently deletes your DayForge account and every project, task, habit, time entry and setting stored on our server. It cannot be undone.
deleteDialogDevice: This device's copy is erased too, once the deletion succeeds. Other devices keep their own copies until their site data is cleared.
deleteFailed: Your account was not deleted ({detail}). Nothing was changed, so you can try again.
syncNotConfigured: Sync is not configured on this build.
